messages.No eligible totals yet. Both device and: No eligible totals yet. Both device and site consent are required; cohorts below five accounts per site/platform/day are withheld. Country is the configured site country, not a person’s location. The same person may count on multiple sites or platforms.

No IP address or browser data is stored. A visitor is recognised only within the same day by a random key that is deleted the next day. A cookie is set only for visitors who arrive via a referral link (?r=code); it holds only the code (30 days). Mention in your privacy policy that statistics are collected.
messages.Automatic: the fast endpoint is tested w: Automatic: the fast endpoint is tested when this page opens; if it fails, REST is used.
messages.Do not count visitors whose browser send: Do not count visitors whose browser sends "Do Not Track" or GPC
messages.Logged-in people with these roles are no: Logged-in people with these roles are not counted. The browser you open this screen in is not counted either (even after logging out).

messages.Your own event: add data-flxan-event=\"n: Your own event: add data-flxan-event="name" (and optional data-flxan-param) to a link, or call flxan.track("name", "detail") in JavaScript. PHP: flxan_track_event( "name", "detail", amount ).
messages.Shows how far visitors get. Each step ca: Shows how far visitors get. Each step can be a page (all pages starting with that path), an event (e.g. the "Pay" click) or the site entry. Up to 5 funnels with 10 steps each. Changes apply to new visits; funnel steps can also be picked as goals on the Journeys screen.

messages.Sites that tick \"Help us improve the pr: Sites that tick "Help us improve the product" in FluxWP Panel send anonymous usage data once a day: which FluxWP plugins are used together, versions, FluxWP PHP errors and setup-wizard progress. IP and site address are not stored; records are kept for 90 days. When enabled, "Product telemetry" appears in the menu.

messages.wp-content/uploads/flx-analytics could n: wp-content/uploads/flx-analytics could not be created or is not writable; visits cannot be recorded. Check the directory permissions (755).
messages.Fast endpoint: visits are recorded witho: Fast endpoint: visits are recorded without loading WordPress.
messages.The fast endpoint failed its test (a sec: The fast endpoint failed its test (a security plugin or the server may block PHP in the plugins folder); the REST endpoint is used. It works, but WordPress loads on every visit.
messages.The REST endpoint is used. It works, but: The REST endpoint is used. It works, but WordPress loads on every visit.
messages.A cache plugin is active; the counter ru: A cache plugin is active; the counter runs in the browser, so cached pages are counted too. The counter script is excluded from combining/delaying.
messages.The counter runs in the browser; countin: The counter runs in the browser; counting continues if a cache plugin is installed.
messages.Processes the queued visits into the tab: Processes the queued visits into the tables right away.
messages.Processing is already running; try again: Processing is already running; try again in a few seconds.
messages.Adds missing columns and tables and upda: Adds missing columns and tables and updates keys. No data is deleted.
messages.Tables could not be updated. The databas: Tables could not be updated. The database user needs the ALTER privilege.
messages.Anonymous data sent once a day by sites: Anonymous data sent once a day by sites that tick "Help us improve the product" in FluxWP Panel. IP and site address are not stored; records are kept for 90 days.
messages.At most one per site per day: At most one per site per day
messages.FluxWP Panel on sites sends to this URL:: FluxWP Panel on sites sends to this URL:
messages.Country comes from the sending site's se: Country comes from the sending site's settings (WooCommerce store country or the Settings › General time zone). IP addresses are never looked up or stored. Click a country to filter every tab by it.
messages.Error record removed. It will reappear i: Error record removed. It will reappear if it happens again.
messages.Server paths, domain, URLs, emails and I: Server paths, domain, URLs, emails and IPs are removed from messages. The same error in the same package, version, file and line is one record; "Sites" is how many different installs saw it.
messages.FluxWP Panel 1.0.11 and later sends the: FluxWP Panel 1.0.11 and later sends the last step and choices when the wizard is finished or closed.
messages.Fast endpoint unreachable, REST will be: Fast endpoint unreachable, REST will be used
messages.Visitors: the sum of unique people per d: Visitors: the sum of unique people per day. A person is recognised only within the same day; someone arriving via a referral link is credited to that code for 30 days. Country is derived from the browser time zone, not the IP.
messages.Compared with the previous period of equ: Compared with the previous period of equal length
messages.Click a row to filter the whole screen b: Click a row to filter the whole screen by that visitor type. For outside traffic only, choose "Outside visitors" at the top.
